read_me.layout: <name>/f00..f04 (fold) and optional w00..w03 (walk), each with scene.gltf and orient.json; geometry lives in bots.pack / walk.pack, decoded by src/botpack.rs
read_me.poses: f00 is the vehicle, f04 the robot; the three between are the fold, evenly spaced in fold time
read_me.morph: accepted = the strip satisfies xform::Morph::build (same prims, same vertex counts, every pose); refused = the game steps the poses instead of folding them

origin.legacy: in the tree before the fleet export; merged per pose, so most refuse the morph

sweep.tuned: in the 113-model line the fold was tuned against
sweep.cold: swept once with the same metric, never tuned against
sweep.none: no metrics exist for this chassis

confidence.high: single blob both views at t=1, symmetry >= 0.85
confidence.low: single blob but asymmetric or scatters mid-fold
confidence.broken: more than one blob at t=1 — expect a piece adrift

read_me.duplicate_of: same source model under a second directory name; the short name is the one older code references
read_me.excluded: Fall-of-Cybertron and other rip-derived models are deliberately absent
